name: audited_zero-gradient_zero-lr_optimizer_pause
mutations: zero current training gradients during the pause
set every current optimizer parameter-group learning rate to zero during the pause
restore the captured native learning rates after 800 optimizer occurrences

mechanism_state_change.rule_margin_reserve: held at its prefix value because parameter motion is suppressed
mechanism_state_change.optimizer_first_moment: continues to decay by 0.9 per zero-gradient optimizer occurrence
mechanism_state_change.optimizer_second_moment: continues to decay by 0.98 per zero-gradient optimizer occurrence
mechanism_state_change.restart_phase: returns to native learning rate with reduced moment buffers

stability_effect_rationale: The pause delays formation, but it does not freeze AdamW step or moment state. Decayed moment buffers increase restart sensitivity, widening the clipped-burst hazard and making transient post-formation margin erosion more likely.
predicted_shift_basis: 800 exactly suppressed parameter updates plus 0 to 400 optimizer steps of restart re-equilibration; the mechanism predicts delay rather than treating the pause as a pure clock translation.
